rationale: Builds directly on the 9x512 recurrent-tail best and spends the next run on an untried export-path idea instead of another small LR/gate sweep. The change keeps the proven architecture and training loop, but upgrades the final int8 roundtrip for the remaining large recurrent-tail tensors: tail `mlp.fc.weight` matrices and the penultimate recurrent-tail `attn.c_v.weight` now use row-offset groupwise int8 scales. That is meant to recover more post-quant fidelity for the winning recurrent-tail path at a much smaller byte cost than full FP16 rescue, while keeping quant-aware roundtrips aligned with the exact final serializer.
title: Tail Groupwise Int8 Rescue
